Meet the award-winning nursing and pumping bra that does it all. Named Nursing Bras & Tanks Product of the Year by the Baby Innovation Awards and honored by Good Housekeeping, this wireless bra lets you nurse, pump hands-free, and get through your day in one comfortable layer.

Start wearing it in late pregnancy, when your body needs more support, and keep it on through postpartum and breastfeeding. The soft, seamless stretch fabric grows and changes with you, and the wire-free design gives gentle, all-day support without digging in.

When it’s time to feed, easy-release nursing clips let you drop a cup with one hand. When it’s time to pump, built-in openings hold your flanges in place so your hands stay free, and it works with wearable pumps too. Adjustable straps and four rows of hook-and-eye closures let you fine-tune the fit as your body shifts day to day.

  • 92% Nylon, 8% Spandex
  • Machine wash cold with like colors. Tumble dry low. Do not bleach or iron.
  • Ideal for the end of pregnancy + postpartum
  • Four rows of hook-and-eye adjustability
  • Hands-free pumping design with flange openings
  • Easy one-handed drop-cup clips and pull-aside nursing access
  • Seamless, wireless design for comfortable support

When it comes to your pregnancy and postpartum wardrobe, it's all about the essentials, and our award-winning nursing bra is at the top of the list. Start wearing it during pregnancy for comfortable support as your body changes, then continue wearing it after baby arrives for easy nursing and pumping. Ultra comfy and built for everyday life, it's the one bra that takes you from bump to baby and beyond.
